source_of_truth: Ground truth declared by the fixture generator when the workspace is built (tests/fixtures/multi_member_workspace.GROUND_TRUTH). Needed because multi-member behaviour cannot be observed on a single repository: four of this feature's decisions only manifest with two or more members, so a single-member benchmark would leave them unguarded.

expectations.assertion: A request-forgery finding located in the browser-only member is RETAINED, because a reachable sibling issues server-side requests, and the enabling member is named.
expectations.baseline: Not previously possible: the applicability relation did not exist, so this could not be suppressed - but a per-member implementation would have suppressed it and introduced a false-negative class that does not exist today.

expectations.assertion: The same finding in a lone browser-only member with no reachable sibling IS remapped, so the relation still does its job.
expectations.baseline: 1 of 2 findings in the reviewed scan was filed as CWE-918 against a browser-only target.

expectations.assertion: A hard-coded host resolving to a sibling member raises no third-party trust finding; a genuinely unowned host does; undetermined ownership is reported as external.
expectations.baseline: The reviewed scan reported the real unowned-host risk only as a secondary note on an unrelated weakness class.

expectations.assertion: Each member is audited against its own ecosystem (npm and PyPI here); a member whose toolchain is absent gets its own named gap rather than being absorbed into a workspace-wide statement.
expectations.baseline: The reviewed scan assessed no ecosystem at all and reported the domain as unassessed in a single Coverage bullet.

expectations.assertion: Architecture profiles are persisted per member so applicability can read them; a member with no profile contributes 'undetermined' rather than narrowing the reachable set.
Templates and configuration files in every member are represented in the code model and assigned to a segment.
expectations.baseline: 0 of 5 file classes represented in the reviewed scan.

expectations.assertion: No coverage gap in any member is caused by a code identifier.
expectations.baseline: 4 of 12 coverage notes in the reviewed scan were identifier false positives.

expectations.assertion: The unified workspace report contains no dangling section reference and no finding contradicting its own verdict.
expectations.baseline: The reviewed report pointed at a High section that did not exist.
